subject: api.loyalspark.online

payload.settle_tx_state: host reported a settlement but its PAYMENT-RESPONSE did not parse into a tx reference
payload.note: a settlement transaction was reported and the retried request was still refused: money moved, nothing was delivered

unmeasured: reliability: n=1 cannot establish whether this host delivers repeatedly
good_faith: a refusal may be rate-limiting, an account requirement, or changed terms — indistinguishable from outside
price_stability: the amount asked was read once and may move
